scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.rust:clippy: cargo clippy -p study-planner-core -p study-planner-store -p study-planner-transfer -p study-planner-updater -p study-planner --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.rust:test: cargo test -p study-planner-core -p study-planner-store -p study-planner-transfer -p study-planner-updater && cargo test -p study-planner
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run rust:fmt && npm run rust:clippy && npm run rust:test
